verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's CLI clearly supports a single local dev command (`npx trigger.dev dev`), confirmed by docs and community praise for 'Dev mode' making testing/iterating smoother, but there is no evidence of dedicated unit-testing utilities that support time skipping or mocking individual steps — the CLI docs only cover develop/self-host/deploy commands, not a test framework/harness. missing for 10: unit-test framework/harness for workflows, time-skipping/travel utilities, mocked-step injection APIs, any independent confirmation of these testing primitives.
